prior: Selected conditional followup before new raw partner outcomes; main diagnostic uses different original/reference case coordinates than prior574vsothercases study.
question: At fixed oracle GTcenter/GTaffine partner coordinates, is the trueGT19 vs falseGT11 appearance order already present in raw RGB/gray or prepared retinal input, and how does it compare with saved C34/R134 representations?
method: Use exactly saved oracle paired coordinates and commonGT/commonexclusive supports. Bilinear sample native raw RGB and OpenCV grayscale; sample original archived retinal eye via same Delaunay geometry. Compute Pearson and Lin concordance per channel, with uniform channel average, on rawRGB/rawgray/preparedretina and all3 saved feature representations. No fitted classifier for raw stages. Same pairs and no query/shift search.
comparisons: For every mapping/support/stage/metric preserve ownminusfalse; positive favors true19, negative favors false11. Stages have different channel semantics. A wrong simple metric does not prove identityinformation absence. Primary fullcommonGT; secondary exclusive support is unknown at fewer3points.
acceptance: All source/parentresult/sample/input hashes unchanged. Independent SciPy pixel and retinal interpolation agree within1e-9.
Independent scalar mean/covariance evaluation of ALL saved pairs agrees within1e-9.
Do not infer a neural cause if the wrong order already appears before the core; change of ordering after core localizes only this fixed comparator/pair, not unique biological cause.
Report every stage/mapping/support and both metrics, preserve disagreement and missing support; no selected favorable examples.
limits: Oracle evaluation uses GT labels and is not deployable
BBox affine/center mapping is not independent visiblepoint correspondence
